summary_1line: Yudhishthira extols forgiveness and restraint over anger, urging Draupadi to trust peace, while Draupadi begins challenging his passive stance.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira calmly instructs Draupadi in the forest while she stands tense and indignant, the Pandavas listening nearby.
Draupadi raises her hands in frustration, bowing ironically to fate while rebuking Yudhishthira for his excessive forgiveness.
